query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `regional_campaigns` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `titleAr` varchar(255),
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `descriptionAr` text,
  `targetRegion` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `targetUserSegment` enum('all', 'new_users', 'returning_users', 'high_value') DEFAULT 'all' NOT NULL,
  `campaignType` enum('seasonal', 'promotional', 'awareness', 'special_event') DEFAULT 'promotional' NOT NULL,
  `bannerImageUrl` text,
  `backgroundColor` varchar(20) DEFAULT '#003366',
  `textColor` varchar(20) DEFAULT '#FFFFFF',
  `ctaText` varchar(100),
  `ctaTextAr` varchar(100),
  `ctaLink` varchar(500),
  `discountPercentage` int,
  `discountCode` varchar(50),
  `startDate` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `endDate` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `isActive` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `priority` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `impressions` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `clicks` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `conversions` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `region_idx` (`targetRegion`),
  INDEX `active_idx` (`isActive`),
  INDEX `date_idx` (`startDate`, `endDate`),
  INDEX `priority_idx` (`priority`)
)
